function updateReaderContent(path): Promise<void>;

Defined in: core/locale/reader-content.ts:58

Replaces the reader article's markup with the prerendered article of path's static page. Responses are cached per path; fetches race safely via the generation counter. A page without a reader article clears the holder (reader mode then correctly finds nothing to offer).

Parameters

path

string

URL path to mirror (e.g. window.location.pathname).

Returns

Promise<void>
